name: Basic Customer Query
description: Get all customers with basic info

body.query: query { chorki_customers { chorki_customers.id chorki_customers.name chorki_customers.email chorki_customers.country chorki_customers.city } }
query { chorki_customers(func: eq(chorki_customers.country, "USA")) { chorki_customers.id chorki_customers.name chorki_customers.email chorki_customers.city chorki_customers.device } }
query { chorki_customers(func: eq(chorki_customers.is_active, true)) { chorki_customers.id chorki_customers.name chorki_customers.email chorki_customers.country chorki_customers.last_login_days } }

name: Customers by Age Range
description: Get customers in specific age range

body.query: query { chorki_customers(func: ge(chorki_customers.age, 25)) @filter(le(chorki_customers.age, 35)) { chorki_customers.id chorki_customers.name chorki_customers.age chorki_customers.country chorki_customers.device } }

query { chorki_subscriptions(func: eq(chorki_subscriptions.package, "Premium")) { chorki_subscriptions.id chorki_subscriptions.customer_id chorki_subscriptions.status chorki_subscriptions.price chorki_subscriptions.auto_renewal } }

query { chorki_contents(func: eq(chorki_contents.genre, "Action")) { chorki_contents.id chorki_contents.title chorki_contents.type chorki_contents.genre chorki_contents.rating chorki_contents.duration } }

query { chorki_contents(func: ge(chorki_contents.rating, 8.0)) @filter(eq(chorki_contents.type, "movie")) { chorki_contents.title chorki_contents.rating chorki_contents.genre chorki_contents.release_year chorki_contents.director } }

name: Watch History by Customer
description: Get watch history for specific customer

body.query: query { chorki_watch_histories(func: eq(chorki_watch_histories.customer_id, "CUST001")) { chorki_watch_histories.id chorki_watch_histories.content_title chorki_watch_histories.type chorki_watch_histories.completion_percentage chorki_watch_histories.device_used } }

name: High Completion Rate
description: Get watch histories with high completion rates

body.query: query { chorki_watch_histories(func: ge(chorki_watch_histories.completion_percentage, 90.0)) { chorki_watch_histories.customer_id chorki_watch_histories.content_title chorki_watch_histories.completion_percentage chorki_watch_histories.quality chorki_watch_histories.device_used } }
query { chorki_customers(func: alloftext(chorki_customers.email, "example.com")) { chorki_customers.id chorki_customers.name chorki_customers.email chorki_customers.country } }

name: Group by Country
description: Group customers by country with count

body.query: query { var(func: type(chorki_customers)) @groupby(chorki_customers.country) { count(uid) } result(func: uid(country)) { chorki_customers.country total_count: val(count) } }

name: Group by Device Type
description: Group customers by device with count

body.query: query { var(func: type(chorki_customers)) @groupby(chorki_customers.device) { count(uid) } result(func: uid(device)) { chorki_customers.device device_count: val(count) } }

query { var(func: type(chorki_subscriptions)) @groupby(chorki_subscriptions.status) { count(uid) total_price: sum(chorki_subscriptions.price) } result(func: uid(status)) { chorki_subscriptions.status status_count: val(count) total_revenue: val(total_price) } }

name: Content Type Distribution
description: Group content by type with average rating

body.query: query { var(func: type(chorki_contents)) @groupby(chorki_contents.type) { count(uid) avg_rating: avg(chorki_contents.rating) } result(func: uid(type)) { chorki_contents.type content_count: val(count) average_rating: val(avg_rating) } }

name: Multi-level Group Query
description: Group customers by country and device

body.query: query { var(func: type(chorki_customers)) @groupby(chorki_customers.country, chorki_customers.device) { count(uid) avg_age: avg(chorki_customers.age) } result(func: uid(country, device)) { chorki_customers.country chorki_customers.device user_count: val(count) average_age: val(avg_age) } }

query { active_customers as var(func: eq(chorki_customers.is_active, true)) @filter(ge(chorki_customers.age, 25)) premium_subs as var(func: eq(chorki_subscriptions.package, "Premium")) @filter(uid_in(chorki_subscriptions.customer_id, uid(active_customers))) result(func: uid(premium_subs)) { chorki_subscriptions.customer_id chorki_subscriptions.package chorki_subscriptions.price chorki_subscriptions.status } }
query { chorki_customers(func: type(chorki_customers), first: 3, offset: 0) { chorki_customers.id chorki_customers.name chorki_customers.email chorki_customers.country } }
query { chorki_customers(func: type(chorki_customers), orderasc: chorki_customers.age) { chorki_customers.id chorki_customers.name chorki_customers.age chorki_customers.country } }
query { count_customers(func: type(chorki_customers)) { count(uid) } }

name: All Types Summary
description: Get count of all entity types

body.query: query { customers(func: type(chorki_customers)) { count(uid) } subscriptions(func: type(chorki_subscriptions)) { count(uid) } contents(func: type(chorki_contents)) { count(uid) } watch_histories(func: type(chorki_watch_histories)) { count(uid) } }
